stage_inventory.early_unanimity_stop: mapped to route_fixed; no duplicate stage task
stage_inventory.same_answer_suppression: mapped to toggle_filter; no duplicate stage task
stage_inventory.answer_grouping: remove_answer_grouping: retain every distinct sender after dissent filtering
stage_inventory.representative_ranking: remove_representative_rank: first candidate in original sender order per answer group, instead of evidence/length ranking
stage_inventory.global_vote_summary: remove_vote_summary: remove prior answer-summary delivery and prompt addition; peer reports retained
stage_inventory.recipient_cap: k=N-1 in executed source; cap removal is identical and adds no distinct setting
stage_inventory.payload_truncation: unset in executed source; no active stage to remove
stage_inventory.candidate_scoring: answer_key parsing/ranking only; no embeddings or paid router in AgentRoute; profiler records actual stage functions
stage_inventory.local_selector: aggregation_controls plus fixed routing/dense controls form required 2x2
stage_inventory.random_fixed_note: Frozen old random_fixed k=3 equals N-1 at N=4; all candidates survive; report this degeneracy rather than claim sparse random advantage

policy_selection: No new policy selection; preserve original development candidate and historical MMLU evidence

scheduling.method_block_rotation: MMLU completion first, other main panels second, then controls; hash(seed=20261031,bucket) within tier; two independent query slots per device

fitting.reuse: exact compatible checkpoint and all 120 training records plus 30 iterations validated

selforg.main: published efficient consensus variant as implemented in pinned source: min >= .95 and range <= .1
selforg.alternate: same source with consensus early termination disabled; original fixed-round variant; common-task adaptation, not native-paper reproduction

self_consistency.derivation: ceil mean original AgentRoute development total tokens: MATH8986.05, BBH3107.3. MMLU uses BBH discrete-answer budget; SVAMP uses math budget. No test outcomes used.
self_consistency.selection: local plurality of admissible answer keys, earliest sample tie break
self_consistency.reservation: exact chat-template prompt + 2048 output before each independent sample

transport.rate_calibration: dense ramps at 1,4,12,32,64,128 qps, 8s steady+2s warm; first >5% failure/drop; low=max(.25,high/4). If bracket not found report saturation unlocated.
transport.rates_freeze: separate immutable network calibration before any transport comparison; no quality-dependent calibration
transport.live_anchor_selection: first 10 fixed math development IDs, independent of outcomes

statistics.primary: MMLU seed17, equal fixed-panel stratum weights as existing manifest
statistics.unit: paired question; seeds clustered by question
statistics.tests: Wilson accuracy; conservative paired gain-harm CI; exact McNemar and Holm7 per dataset; stratified paired token-ratio bootstrap
statistics.margin_status: inherited screening threshold, not validated application acceptance criterion; never widen

persistence.controller_location: Modal CPU sandbox; single-writer SQLite on its mounted Volume, not shared across writers
persistence.commit: v2 sync after closed task records; provider readback SHA before acceptance; coordinator syncs /workspace after checkpoint
persistence.failed_attempts: retained with usage and immutable journals

measurement_contract.old_telemetry: reuse only measured fields; per-request server waits and per-stage details missing in v11 remain missing until separately measured
measurement_contract.physical_bytes: packet capture on isolated transport NIC; HTTP body not a wire-byte substitute
measurement_contract.timing: profiler overhead included, old and new timing cohorts separate
measurement_contract.required_measurement_supplements: new MMLU telemetry on fixed ablation subset for methods with historical-only records; cannot substitute old quality outcome/latency
